args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of ~18%. Per the runbook, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms checkout-api is healthy in all regions running v2.3.0 with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure requires investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all production regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions running v2.3.0, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: Documented the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. On-call has been paged, and root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 is flagged as the follow-up.
